hack.root_cause: Compromised 3-of-4 multisig → forged deposit proofs → cross-chain withdrawal drain
hack.description: Poly Network's second exploit lost $4.4M when three of its four multisig keys were compromised, allowing forged withdrawal proofs — a simpler attack than its $600M first hack but an equally avoidable one.
